description.value: A 35-site lakeside campground in Douglas fir and larch forest just 4 km on paved road from Cranbrook, with a sandy beach, swimming, and fishing for rainbow trout and largemouth bass. The gate closes outside the operating season, so confirm dates before planning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms an active 35-site frontcountry campground with potable water (corroborated by OSM drinking_water=yes), toilets, and a BC Parks reservation system (OSM reservation=recommended). Cycling is explicitly listed as a park activity, with a notable restriction that e-bikes are not permitted on trails and are confined to park roads. No showers, food services, laundry, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) and email (info@ekparks.com) belong to park operator EK Parks Ltd., not BC Parks directly; the BC Parks website lists different general contact details (1-800-689-9025 / parkinfo@gov.bc.ca). The operator number may still be valid for campground-specific queries but could not be confirmed from the website.
E-bikes are explicitly prohibited on park trails and restricted to park roads only — directly relevant to e-bike touring cyclists considering this stop.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks frontcountry campground near Cranbrook with cycling listed as a park activity, potable water, toilets, and a reservation system — a solid and well-documented stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 3/95 corridor.

wow_evidence: Cycling is explicitly listed as a park activity
